title.narrative: Programa de Apoyo al Sector Elctrico I

description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa de Apoyo al Sector Electrico I y II (del cual NI-L1021 y NI-L1022 forman parte) es el de apoyar al gobierno de Nicaragua en la creacin de condiciones esenciales para viabilizar la operacin fsica y financiera del sector elctrico en el mediano plazo. El objetivo especfico es el de reforzar el sistema de transmisin y generacin y fortalecer la institucionalidad responsable de la definicin de polticas y regulacin del sector elctrico.

The objective of the program to support the electricity sector is to collaborate with Nicaragua in the establishment of essential conditions for improvement of the technical and financial conditions of the sector in the mid-term. The specific objective to reinforce the transmission and generation investments to help sustain the reliability and security of supply in the system and also to collaborate with the improvement of the institutional conditions in the sector.
